title: Numeric sorting
goal: Sort prices numerically without changing the source array.
hint: The default sort compares text. Does sorting mutate its input?

title: UTC calendar dates
goal: Return the YYYY-MM-DD UTC date for an ISO timestamp.
hint: The input offset may cross a UTC calendar boundary.

title: Empty averages
goal: Average a list of finite measurements; an empty list returns null.
hint: What should division by zero mean to the caller?

title: Money totals
goal: Add nonnegative decimal prices with at most two decimal places and return integer cents.
hint: Convert each price to integer cents before summing.

title: Required fields
goal: Validate a nonempty string email field without throwing for null or wrong types.
hint: Validate the container and field type before calling string methods.

title: Awaiting collections
goal: Return an array of resolved doubled values.
hint: Awaiting an array does not await the promises inside it.

title: Duplicate events
goal: Sum amounts once per event ID, preserving the first occurrence.
hint: Keep the IDs you have already processed.

title: Dictionary keys
goal: Count arbitrary string keys safely, including names inherited by ordinary objects.
hint: Consider Map instead of a plain object for user-supplied keys.

title: Visible characters
goal: Count user-perceived grapheme clusters, including emoji and combining marks.
hint: String length counts UTF-16 code units.

title: Pagination boundaries
goal: Return a 1-based page using a positive page size.
hint: Array offsets begin at zero; pages in this contract begin at one.
